name: NY-25
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Morelle's large fundraising and cash advantage
Polymarket prices Morelle at ~97% to win
model.rationale: Morelle is a well-funded incumbent in a D+10 district, while McIntyre has raised only about $32,000 and has no outside support. Prediction markets price Morelle near 97%, and no evidence suggests a competitive race.
model.watch: A late surge of outside spending against Morelle or an unexpectedly strong challenger campaign would be the main signals of movement.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Joseph Morelle, the Democratic incumbent, is seeking another term in a Rochester-area district that leans about ten points Democratic. He has raised nearly $1.8 million and holds over $400,000 in cash, with outside groups supporting him and none opposing. Republican Virginia McIntyre has raised only about $32,000 and enters the race with little visibility or financial backing.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets give Morelle roughly a 97% chance of winning. The fundamentals point to a comfortable incumbent victory, with the main uncertainty being the absence of direct polling rather than any sign of a genuine contest.
